description: Converts a platform-agnostic flight_plan.json (from the 'flight_plan' step) into drone/GCS-specific mission files, one file per battery/tank-limited charge cycle, via the export-flight-mission Tapis app. Sprayer control is emitted as MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SERVO toggling a configurable servo/relay channel — portable across ArduPilot and PX4. The DJI (.kmz) output's spray-action tag and drone/payload enum values are unverified placeholders (DJI's public docs cover camera/gimbal actions, not Agras spray control) — see the drone_enum_value/payload_enum_value/spray_action_tag/spray_param_tag fields below; swap in real values once confirmed against an actual DJI Pilot 2 / Agras export.

format.description: Which mission format(s) to export. 'all' produces every format at once, each in its own subfolder.

waypoint_hold_s.description: ArduPilot only: seconds the aircraft holds at each waypoint (NAV_WAYPOINT param1). 1.0 makes it pause briefly at every point, which is what a survey/camera flight wants; 0 flies straight through.

takeoff_pitch.description: ArduPilot only: minimum pitch in degrees for the NAV_TAKEOFF item that now starts every mission file.

cam_trigger_dist_m.description: ArduPilot only: trigger the camera every N metres (MAV_CMD_DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST), for flying a plan as a survey. 0 omits the command entirely.

emit_sprayer_servo.description: ArduPilot only: include the DO_SET_SERVO sprayer on/off items. Off by default - an airframe with no sprayer should not carry servo commands for an unwired channel.

sprayer_servo_channel.description: Servo/relay output channel number the sprayer valve is wired to (MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SERVO channel).

sprayer_pwm_on.description: PWM value (microseconds) that switches the sprayer ON.

sprayer_pwm_off.description: PWM value (microseconds) that switches the sprayer OFF.

hover_speed_mps.description: PX4 .plan only: the hoverSpeed field — speed PX4 uses for vertical/hovering maneuvers, separate from horizontal cruise speed. Has no effect on ArduPilot or DJI output.

cruise_speed_mps.description: PX4 .plan only: horizontal cruise speed, in meters per second. Optional — leave blank to derive it automatically from flight_plan.json's meta.speed_mph instead.

drone_enum_value.description: DJI WPML drone model enum value. UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER — only affects the 'dji' output; DJI's spray-control schema isn't publicly documented. Confirm against a real DJI Pilot 2 / Agras export before relying on this.

drone_sub_enum_value.description: DJI WPML drone sub-model enum value. UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER — same caveat as drone_enum_value.

payload_enum_value.description: DJI WPML payload (sprayer) enum value. UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER — same caveat as drone_enum_value.

spray_action_tag.description: DJI WPML action tag name used to enable the sprayer. UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER — same caveat as drone_enum_value.

spray_param_tag.description: DJI WPML action parameter tag name for the sprayer. UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER — same caveat as drone_enum_value.

tapis_job.name: mission-export
tapis_job.description: Export platform-specific drone missions from a flight plan
